A calming, attentive approach is what sets Cutting Edge Ladies Salon | Silicon Central | DSO apart, with clients praising the therapists’ professional massages for easing tension and leaving them refreshed. The stylists also listen closely when shaping haircuts, while nail technicians take care with pedicures, creating visits that feel considered and leave clients relaxed and pleased with their results.
